entries.purpose: Approved and prospective vendors with category, owner, renewal date, risk tier, current contract value, and escalation contact.
Weighted scoring rubrics for vendor proposals, including commercial, technical, security, implementation, support, and legal criteria.
Spend thresholds, quote-count requirements, approval roles, non-standard term flags, and external-communication rules.
Negotiation fallback ranges for price, liability, term length, termination rights, DPA, audit rights, and SLA credits.
Contracted service levels, measurement windows, breach thresholds, credit remedies, and notification obligations.
Prior approval packets, approver decisions, conditions, rejected terms, and evidence that shortened later review cycles.
